remarks: Spacious and thoughtfully renovated, this 3-bedroom townhome in the coveted Hathaway Common community offers a perfect blend of modern living and classic charm, with a prime location in the heart of New Canaan. The open-concept layout on the main floor welcomes visitors with an effortless flow between the kitchen, dining, and living areas - ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. Sliding doors lead to a large, enclosed private patio with an expansive awning, extending the living space to the outdoors. Upstairs offers a retreat with three comfortable bedrooms and two full baths, including a generously-sized primary suite with a beautifully-updated ensuite bath, walk-in closet, and a private office. Laundry on this level adds everyday convenience. The well-designed finished lower level provides fantastic additional living space with a family room/theater for movie nights, an exercise area/flex space, and a second office or creative space. Hathaway Common is known for its sense of community and desirable amenities, including a swimming pool, pool house, and manicured green spaces. Sidewalks along South Avenue make it an easy stroll to New Canaan's vibrant village center for shopping, restaurants, library, and the train station. Come discover the lifestyle and convenience waiting for you at Hathaway Common!
